title: The sarcomere shortens, the filaments do not
caption: In contraction the myosin heads pull the actin filaments towards the middle. The Z lines move closer, the I band and H zone shrink and may vanish, but the A band, which is the length of the myosin filament, stays the same: the filaments slide past each other and keep their length.
alt: Two sarcomeres drawn to scale, relaxed at 2.4 micrometres and contracted at 1.8: the thin actin filaments from each Z line slide inwards over the central thick myosin filament; the A band stays 1.6 micrometres while the I band falls from 0.8 to 0.2 and the H zone from 0.4 to nothing.
description: Relaxed: sarcomere 2.4 µm; A band 1.6 µm, I band 0.8 µm, H zone 0.4 µm.
Contracted: sarcomere 1.8 µm; A band still 1.6 µm, I band 0.2 µm, H zone gone.
Myosin heads form cross-bridges with actin and pivot, pulling the thin filaments inwards.
The sarcomere shortens by 0.6 µm but no filament changes length.
